overview: A Caffeine-native control center for the isolated Magick Box on ICP prototype — configure external ICP canisters, manage provider endpoints, create payment intents, and explore the Magick Box UX without touching production systems.
features: Dark Magick Box UI shell with hero and navigation
Magick Friend composer with Image, Video, and Music modes
ICP canister configuration for core, media, ledger, ad verifier, and AI worker
Provider settings for FreeLLMAPI, OpenAI-compatible, MagickAI, and Ollama endpoints
Payment intent management with ICRC-2 transfer-from payloads and manual verification
Gallery of locally generated media with job metadata
Job history with prompt, mode, provider, and status
System status dashboard showing live vs. external ICP vs. user-required features
Deployment checklist mapping control center features to real ICP canister steps
